Create a complete wide landscape static SLG conscription UI candidate, approximately 1916:821. References 1 mail and 2 team are highest priority art style: jade green, warm ivory silk/paper, fine warm gold rounded cloud frames, polished Daoist chibi HD hand-painted finish. Reference 3 gives ONLY the conscription functional structure and arithmetic; discard its old people and banners. Reference 4 is original master identity contact sheet, top-left METAL woman, top-middle WOOD man; reference 5 is the newly redesigned formation page for the same two portraits and names and UI continuity. Use the same master faces, short silver bob versus brown half-up hair, wardrobe, ruler+compass versus bamboo staff. No historical figures, no old black-haired female mage, no pixel-copy claim. Keep existing master pose, no new action.

Title 征兵, small subtitle 第一部队; top left 返回 arrow and top right X. Upper right resource summary wheat icon 粮草 8000 | coin icon 铜钱 5000. Two broad portrait/unit panels in left two-thirds: 大营 and 中军, ivory/gold frames and jade header. 大营 is young adult silver-gray short-haired woman 铸锋使 with amber eyes, flower/cloud jade clasp, ivory/jade robe, gold guards, rectangular rune ruler and jade-center array compass. 中军 is young brown-haired male 青蘅使 with leaf/jade hairpin, green leaf capelet, ivory/jade robe, bamboo staff, seed pouch. Both portrait crops respect complete face and recognizable tools; card names unobscured.

Each card has exact rows 当前兵力 500 / 1000; 目标兵力 1000 with full jade slider whose min/max are 500 and 1000; 新增兵力 +500 in green. Both characters have the same values. Right top section 征兵消耗: row 粮草 需要 10000 | 持有 8000 | red warning 不足 2000; row 铜钱 需要 2000 | 持有 5000 | green check; row hourglass 预计时间 00:20:00. Consistent distinct wheat and coin illustrations.

Right lower section 预备役: UNCHECKED square 使用预备役, 可用 200, 立即补满需 1000, red triangle 预备役不足. Do not enable the instant reserve option. Bottom left ivory button 返回配置. Bottom center summary clear three fields 当前总兵力 1000 -> 目标总兵力 2000 | 本次新增兵力 +1000. Bottom right large grey disabled button with lock 粮草不足, under it small red 请降低目标兵力或补充粮草. No green enabled confirm button because grain is insufficient. Small muted footer 演示配置. Preserve original functional hierarchy and self-consistent arithmetic, all text readable, no paper/ornament overlaps. Sunny training courtyard with neutral jade pennants, no new official game title, no official cost/time rule established. Native complete UI painting no upscaling.
